en.headline: Three appear in court after 38 kg ketamine seizure at airport
en.dek: Customs said two passengers arriving from Rome and one from Kuala Lumpur were charged with trafficking dangerous drugs after officers found about 38 kilograms of suspected ketamine worth some HK$15 million.
body: Three people charged over two airport drug cases were due to appear at West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Thursday after Hong Kong Customs seized about 38 kilograms of suspected ketamine with an estimated market value of about HK$15 million.

Customs said officers on Tuesday stopped a 51-year-old local woman and a 26-year-old local man arriving from Rome. About 36 kilograms of suspected ketamine were found in their checked-in suitcases. Both were jointly charged with trafficking in a dangerous drug.

In a separate case the same day, a 40-year-old mainland man arriving from Kuala Lumpur was arrested after officers found about two kilograms of suspected ketamine hidden in a false compartment of his checked-in luggage. He was charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug.

Customs said it would continue to use intelligence analysis and risk assessment, including extra checks on passengers from higher-risk routes. The department again warned the public not to carry controlled items for others in return for payment.

zh.headline: 機場檢38公斤懷疑氯胺酮 三人今西九龍提堂
zh.dek: 海關在兩宗旅客案件共檢獲約38公斤懷疑K仔，市值約1,500萬元，三人被控販運危險藥物。
body: 香港海關在香港國際機場偵破兩宗旅客販毒案，檢獲共約38公斤懷疑氯胺酮，估計市值約1,500萬元。三名被告今日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示，周二一名51歲本地女子及一名26歲本地男子由意大利羅馬抵港，關員在他們的寄倉行李箱內發現共重約36公斤懷疑氯胺酮，兩人同被控一項販運危險藥物罪。
同日另一案中，一名40歲內地男子由馬來西亞吉隆坡抵港，關員在其寄倉行李夾層檢獲約兩公斤懷疑氯胺酮，他被控一項販運危險藥物罪。
海關指會繼續按情報分析及風險管理加強打擊跨境販毒，包括重點查驗來自較高風險地區的旅客，並呼籲市民勿因金錢利益代運受管制物品。
